cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Tell the children the trip's postponed for bus repairs. They'll worry about Mr Patel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then everyone says, 'Mr Patel is fine; the bus needs repairs.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Same sentence for the office. We don't need three versions of his afternoon.

mechanism: Protect the driver through a shared account shaped by copying a boiler announcement without understanding its scope.
confusable: Not knowing concealment alone: B2 must expose the mistaken copied maintenance claim, and A3 must cover without admitting it.
comparison: Workplace public reassurance differs from the family speech in alternative b.
seedUse: Retains the canonical Drive bus/parents reassurance and S04 copied-confidence logic; no provisional seeds.
